english.note: Use 想要 to make the desire more explicit or stronger, especially when wanting a thing, an action, or someone sexually.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 jiu3 ni1 fan6 gung1

english.note: Use this for a straightforward statement of wanting or desiring an object or action rather than an offer-question.

exampleSentences.english: I would like to buy this book.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 maai5 ni1 bun2 syu1
